About this collection and read aloud

Books One through Eleven are included in reading order, with 334 story chapters and all ten original illustrations. Book Eight contains its two existing chapters. Book Nine is the revised forty-chapter, 40,012-word edition. Book Ten is The House of Open Windows, in thirty-two chapters. Book Eleven is The Sea Between Our Names, in forty chapters. The earlier planning companion appears last and contains spoilers; its plans may differ from the published stories. Duplicate copies of Book Eight’s chapters appear once.

The complete text and artwork are inside this file. Read aloud uses your browser’s voices. Offline speech requires a voice installed on your device; voices labeled “local” are the best choice for offline use. Speech availability and background playback depend on your browser.
